4. Churrascaria Vulcao, LLC
       D/B/A: Churrascaria Vulcao, Location: 203 ADAMS ST DORCHESTER, MA 02122,
       License#: LB‑336046, Notice/Violation#: INFOHEARING, Category: CV7MWN
       Date            Notice
       10/23/2020 Mandatory informational hearing regarding ownership/beneficial interest
       in the Licensee entity; Manager of Record of the Licensee entity; oversight and control of
       the day to day operations of the Licensee entity; and the execution and filing of the
       annual Renewal application for the Licensee entity; Allegation that the Licensee no
       longer has the legal right to occupy the premise in violation of M.G.L. ch. 138 s. 15A, ch.
        138 138 s. 16A, M.G.L. 138 s. 23, M.G.L. ch. 138 s. 26, M.G.L. ch. 138 s. 64.
Licensee has seven (7) days to provide the Board proof of the legal right to occupy the
premise as well as sworn statements regarding the ownership and operational of the
premise. Should the Licensee fail to provide adequate documentation in Board’s discretion
pursuant to this vote by 5:00pm on December 10, 2020 the License shall be revoked as of
December 18, 2020 and the Licensee must cease operations.
ambiguity_notes: Revocation is conditional on later failure to supply adequate records. This document does not establish that the condition occurred or that the license was ultimately revoked.
